name_common: Dartos muscle (smooth muscle of the scrotum and labia majora)

attachments.origin_landmark: no bony attachment: smooth-muscle sheet in the subcutaneous tissue of the scrotum (male) and labia majora (female), continuous with the membranous layer of the superficial perineal fascia (the schema takes a bone id; the true attachment is cartilage/skin and is named in the landmark text)
attachments.insertion_landmark: skin of the scrotum / labia majora and the scrotal septum

innervation.root_levels: L1-L2 (sympathetic postganglionic fibres carried in the genital branch of the genitofemoral nerve)

actions: wrinkles the scrotal skin and draws the testes toward the body in cold (thermoregulation); smooth muscle, not under voluntary control

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population

fiber_architecture.evidence: no measured architecture recorded: no PCSA, fascicle length or force verified from a source for this muscle (Q65 rule: numbers only where a source gives them)

functional_compartments.function_note: Smooth muscle, so no skeletal-muscle architecture applies; listed because Z-Anatomy and TA name it. Not a botulinum or PRP target in this atlas.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
